slug: 2025-04-11 Local Businesses Benefit from Burkina Faso's Internet Development (BFIX)

facts.fact: BFIX, the Burkina Faso Internet Exchange, launched in June 2015 and is described by the Internet Society as in service as the resilience backbone keeping local traffic flowing.
Traffic: 6 Gbps (peak) at BFIX, up from 0.5 Gbps after 2019 Internet Society support; the document gives no date for the figure, so its publication date is used (Internet Society).

Burkina Faso has IXP peering in operation: per Internet Society Pulse, 80% of networks are IXP members or customers of IXP members and traffic exchange capacity has grown consistently over five years; the exchange is not named in this document.

note: Other exchanges named (COTIX, RINEX, MGIX, LLIX) are in other countries.
The only exchange point named (CENIX) is in Central African Republic; nothing stated for BFA.
Exchanges named (NAPAfrica, JINX, KIXP, IXPN Lagos) are in other countries; nothing for BFA.
